parts.label: Capsule (slime layer)
parts.info: Sticky polysaccharide coat that protects against drying and immune attack.

parts.label: Cell wall (peptidoglycan)
parts.info: Murein wall that keeps the cell's shape; target of penicillin.

parts.label: Cell membrane
parts.info: Controls transport; also the site of respiration in bacteria.

parts.label: Nucleoid (circular DNA)
parts.info: A single circular chromosome, not enclosed by a nuclear membrane.

parts.label: Plasmids
parts.info: Small extra DNA loops, often carrying antibiotic-resistance genes.

parts.label: 70S ribosomes
parts.info: Smaller than eukaryotic 80S ribosomes; make proteins.

parts.label: Flagellum
parts.info: Rotating helical filament that moves the bacterium.

parts.label: Pili
parts.info: Hair-like projections for attachment and passing DNA in conjugation.
